test_title: PYST 40: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the sister of B'

A - B means 'A is the husband of B'

A × B means 'A is the son of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the mother of B'

Based on the above, how is F related to J if 'F × G - H ÷ I + J' ?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Husband
 Son
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: F × G - H ÷ I + J

It means: F is the Son of G, G is the Husband of H, H is the Mother of I, I is the Sister of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/340b49d34cbad39bb08359b20423d97669d8397e1c1ca4f7932ac17a60d855fc.png] 

So, F is the 'Brother' of J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
